newsitem.title: INDIA: India's ITC director Vevaina resigns.
newsitem.headline: India's ITC director Vevaina resigns.

text.p: India's tobacco and hotel conglomerate ITC Ltd said on Monday that it has accepted the resignation of executive director F.R. Vevaina from the company's board for health reasons.
A company spokesman told Reuters the board of directors accepted Vevaina's resignation at its last meeting on June 15.
"His resignation is purely on health grounds. He has been suffering from heart problems for quite some time," the spokesman said.
Vevaina, formerly ITC's vice chairman, had already resigned from the board of ITC Classic Finance Ltd.
ITC is 31.7 percent owned by Britain's B.A.T Industries Plc.
